newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stocks up on short-covering, fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian stocks up on short-covering, fund buying.

text.p: Share prices closed higher at major Indian stock exchanges on Wednesday as short-covering by operators pushed up prices, dealers said.
The 30-share index of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) rose 45.80 points, or 1.49 percent, to close at 3,126.06, off the day's high of 3,135.69.
Traders said operators who had short-sold last week were squaring positions on the first day of regular trade at the BSE.
The National Stock Exchange was open on Monday. But all other major stock exchanges were closed on Monday and Tuesday for Diwali, the Hindu Festival of Lights.
